gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-rowan: Gentle, literary letterforms with generous curve openings make Rowan feel like a friendly text serif. Rowan's hairlines run about half the weight of its stems, while Lugrasimo's hand-drawn, loose line adds an inviting warmth above.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-spline-sans: Loose and hand-drawn up top, with stencil-cut letters and mild bar variation. Lugrasimo brings the personality, and Spline Sans keeps its strokes unpinched and uniform in weight, with wide gaps at the curves.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-synonym: Lugrasimo writes its heading loose and hand-drawn, with a soft shift between fat and slim strokes. Its charm is in that friendly looseness, while Synonym does its best work as a sans of single steady thickness with generous curve openings.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-lora: Lugrasimo sets a friendly, hand-drawn heading with a loose, spread-out line and no ink pooling in the turns. Lora follows with bookish hairline thinning at the curves, and that handwritten-meets-literary mix is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-outfit: Friendly, in a loose hand-drawn way, Lugrasimo offers soft contrast that never looks flat or stark. Outfit does its best work as a sans with a ballpoint-like stroke, curves finishing well before they close.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-plus-jakarta-sans: Lugrasimo gives the heading a hand-drawn, friendly line, with a measured swell from hairline to stem. Plus Jakarta Sans, in single-weight monoline, would feel lost if the heading were shrunk.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-space-grotesk: Friendly and loose, Lugrasimo draws its heading by hand with tame contrast that never goes razor thin. And Space Grotesk, a plain sans of unvarying line weight with breathing counters, gives that warmth a geometric floor to stand on.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-amulya: Amulya reads as contemporary and modern, with curve gaps that stay generous and a low profile. Amulya then sits beneath Lumanosimo's casual, pen-and-paper heading, which has no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-neco: Lumanosimo writes casually, with graceful strokes where horizontal bars match the upright stems exactly. Neco steps in with a dignified, authoritative voice, sturdy hairlines beside moderate stems, so the two feel like a note scribbled beside a formal page.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-plein: Plein is reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Plein is also the one to enlarge a little if you want more presence, leaving Lumanosimo's full-width stroke connections as they are.
